name: OpenMetadata
description: OpenMetadata metadata/data-catalog platform, deployed with the official Docker Compose release asset (server, ingestion/Airflow, MySQL, Elasticsearch).

notes.text: Docker was used because upstream publishes no complete bare-metal install path: the release ships docker-compose.yml as the documented local deployment. A bare-metal attempt is kept as ct/openmetadata-baremetal.sh but is known broken.
Not intended for production use as-is: default credentials, no auth on internal services (MySQL/Elasticsearch), single-host only.
First start can take several minutes while MySQL and Elasticsearch bootstrap and the migration container runs before the server comes up.
Default login: admin@open-metadata.org / admin. The Airflow ingestion UI is on port 8080 with admin / admin. Change both before exposing this instance beyond your local network.
